topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The day started like any other, but the moment I saw the dirt disturbed in the corner of my yard, everything changed. It was odd, a spot I was certain I hadn’t touched. My hands trembled slightly as I knelt and began to clear the soil with a small trowel. There, hidden beneath the earth, was a metal box, cold and whispering of secrets. I hesitated, my heart thudding in my chest. The box was old, perhaps decades, and definitely not one I recalled placing there. What could it hold? My mind raced with possibilities, each one more unsettling than the last. The world around me seemed to quiet, as if waiting for what I would find inside.
